payload.rationale: The obligation asks which of eight Outfall 001 parameters (Flow, dissolved copper, dissolved cadmium, hardness, TSS monthly average, TSS daily maximum, total aluminum, total copper) support numeric exceedance comparison versus report-only monitoring. The packet provides limit-table excerpts for only three parameter rows. Per-parameter assessment from grounded spans: Flow shows Report MGD for both limit columns (per-parameter REJECT for numeric comparison). Dissolved copper shows Report for both applicable columns (per-parameter REJECT). Total Suspended shows Report for the monthly-average column and 50 for the daily-maximum column (per-parameter REJECT for monthly average; per-parameter ACCEPT for daily maximum). No packet span addresses dissolved cadmium, hardness, total aluminum, or total copper, so applicability for those four parameters cannot be established from this evidence. Because half the requested parameters lack any packet grounding and the evidenced parameters yield mixed per-parameter results (three report-only, one numeric), neither aggregate ACCEPT nor REJECT is supportable without unsupported semantic closure.
